outcome: extension of lower uterine segment incision
cohort: The study participants were women who underwent a caesarean section in the second stage of labour.
finding: Second-stage caesarean sections are associated with a high incidence of maternal morbidities like PPH requiring blood transfusion and neonatal morbidities such as birth asphyxia and meconium aspiration syndrome.
mod_finding: Findings indicated that second-stage caesarean sections carry increased risks of specific maternal (e.g., PPH) and neonatal (e.g., birth asphyxia) morbidities.
gest_age: Most babies were between 37 weeks and 38 weeks and 6 days gestational age.
